DETERMINISTIC_RISK.note: never reached: the router returned no trade, so no signal was sized

RECONCILIATION.note: every cycle ends with a recorded terminal state

SIGNAL.note: zero signals: no admitted strategy exists, so the router has nothing to ask for one

GATE_INTACT.what_it_is: the committed admission ledger, unmodified: the strategy under test has to be admitted by a committed research artifact before the router will let it reach risk

SANDBOX_ADMISSION.reading: the risk and broker boundary is reachable: once a strategy is admitted the same canonical path produces orders and closed fills. That certifies connectivity, not admissibility
SANDBOX_ADMISSION.what_it_is: a declared sandbox ledger placed in this package's scratch directory, admitting one family so the downstream stages can be exercised. It is not an admission and nothing here promotes it

cap004_real_decision_path.reconciled_against: the PAPER_REPLAY execution, which drives the same canonical pipeline with a ledger at every stage and localises the stop to the router
cap004_real_decision_path.why_zero_paper_orders: the CAP-004 real-decision path writes decision and outcome records but no order-intent, router or broker record, so the path's middle is unobserved there: `0` in that window is a weakly-asserted zero (nothing would have recorded an intent had one existed), not a measured absence of trading

capacity.reading: the guardian keeps the campaign's own thresholds (5 GiB healthy, 2 GiB critical); capacity was recovered from regenerable caches and scratch, no evidence artifact was deleted and no limit was lowered

edge14_clone_prune.note: shallow bare clones fetched by the previous RFC-EDGE-014 pass; re-fetchable from the pinned SHAs

mypy_cache_prune.note: type-check cache; regenerated on next mypy run

pip_cache_purge.note: regenerable download cache; no project evidence

pycache_prune.note: bytecode caches; regenerated on next import

pytest_temp_prune.note: pytest tmp_path scratch older than 2h; pytest's own retention policy keeps the recent ones

cause_of_no_paper_orders.measured: 1758 of 1758 router invocations on the authoritative arm returned no trade
cause_of_no_paper_orders.why: config/strategy_admission.json admits nothing: every strategy in it is NO_GROSS_EDGE or not measured under the cost model, so the gate that protects capital refuses before sizing
on the sandbox arm the broker refused 1134 of 1528 risk-accepted decisions: an order with no fill is a normal broker outcome, not a missing stage

connectivity_verdict: the pipeline runs end to end: contexts are built, the router is invoked, risk accepts and the broker fills — on the arm that has an admitted strategy. On the authoritative arm the funnel stops at the router by design, and that stop is the gate working, not a broken stage
execution_class_reading: historical bars driven through the canonical paper path; this is real execution of the runtime's code but NOT prospective observation, because every bar predates the run
limitations: PAPER_REPLAY is historical bars replayed through the runtime: it is real execution of the project's code and NOT prospective observation, because every bar predates the run
one dataset, two symbols, one timeframe and one family certify the path, not an edge
the sandbox ledger is a scratch input that admits a family for connectivity testing; no result from it may be treated as a research finding
the disk guard refuses only on CRITICAL; a WARNING state still permits new decision slots, so the earlier 42 refusals were capacity-driven and are resolved by capacity, not by loosening the guard
unknown_is_not_zero: a stage without a ledger is reported UNKNOWN and a zero is only asserted where a ledger that would have recorded the event exists; the CAP-004 path is weak-zero for intent, broker and fill, and the PAPER_REPLAY arm is a strong zero because its ledger is present and counted
